??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Don't lean on that rail. I tied it, so it will hold, but I don't like leaning. Anything that sways makes me suspicious, *Player*, and a good deal sways around here.
    - Those stakes went into the far end of the bridge, and the lashings are doubled now. I don't send the young ones out alone any more. Not until I know what's chewing my ropes.
    - Cliff gnawers. Nests under the anchor ledge, teeth like chisels, and they come up in the dark. I knew it was something. Now I know what, and I can tie against it.
    - Thrun and I fitted the new hide, two old fools arguing over every lashing. The stand held. I built that stand when we were both young, you know. It has held every feast since.
    - Well? Say it, then.
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* What's wrong on the far bridge?
        - *Choice:* Let's keep the night watch on the Far Anchor.

    - Vosk, master of bridges. Three generations of Kragvar learned to splice a cable from me, and Brakka is the fourth, though she'd sooner carve stairs. I trust a knot once I've tied it myself.
    - Twice this season I found ropes on the far canyon bridge gnawed half through in the night, always on the side away from town. I spliced them and doubled the lashings. I don't know what does it, and I haven't said so in council.
    - The far canyon bridge carries herders, hunters and masons out to the far slopes. Now it carries them safe, and I sleep. Mostly. I still walk it at dawn.
    - Night on the Far Anchor, then. Keep the gnawers off the anchors till the light comes, and Brakka and I will hold the ropes. Don't let them reach the knots.
